text:
Samir Patel: Heads upflying SFO -> KEF -> AMS for the summit. 10h layover in Reykjavik. Any survival tips?
Dana Ortiz: If it's long, buy a lounge day pass (showers + nap chairs). KEF has Plaza Premium.
Tom Becker: Power bank, eye mask, earplugs. Also find a quiet gate area if you plan to sleep.
Priya Nair: If you can clear passport control, do a quick city loop. Reykjavik is close enough for 2-3 hours out.
sasha-bot: Reminder: add your layover details to the team itinerary so pickups sync.
Samir Patel: Is it risky to leave transit area with checked bag?
Dana Ortiz: Check if bags are checked through. If not, use left-luggage at the airport or keep valuables with you.
Tom Becker: For hygiene: wipes, toothpaste tablets, deodorant stick. Lounge showers = game changer.
Priya Nair: Pack a spare clean shirt and socks in a compression pouch. Trust me.
Samir Patel: Any plug/adapter recs?
Dana Ortiz: EU/UK adapters depending on the route. Multi-port USB-C charger is clutch.
Tom Becker: And screenshots of boarding passes + eSIM ready. Save critical demo files offline if you plan to work in transit.
Samir Patel: Perfect. I'll grab a lounge pass and pack a tiny kit. Thanks! :thumbsup:
